description: Extract live Skill Mastery ranks, player-facing effects, card access, Research boundaries, and account-wide totals without changing save state
target: Skill Mastery account effects and totals

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_mining_experience
extractions.description: Mining experience gain: twenty-five percentage points when the Mining rank is above zero

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_mining_efficiency
extractions.description: Mining efficiency: ten percentage points when the Mining rank is above one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_smithing_forge_capacity
extractions.description: Smithing forge ore capacity: twenty-five percentage points when the Smithing rank is above zero

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_alchemy_liquid_capacity
extractions.description: Alchemy liquid capacity: five percentage points when the Alchemy rank is above one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_construction_shrine_rate
extractions.description: Construction shrine level-up rate: fifteen percentage points when the Construction rank is above one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_breeding_egg_speed
extractions.description: Breeding egg incubation speed: fifteen percentage points when the Breeding rank is above one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_sailing_speed
extractions.description: Sailing boat speed: seventeen percentage points when the Sailing rank is above one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_divinity_points
extractions.description: Divinity points gained: fifteen percentage points when the Divinity rank is above one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_gaming_bits
extractions.description: Gaming bits gain: a 1.15 multiplier represented by fifteen percentage points above Gaming rank one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_farming_crop_chance
extractions.description: Farming crop evolution chance: a 1.15 multiplier represented by fifteen percentage points above Farming rank one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_sneaking_jade_coins
extractions.description: Sneaking jade coin gain: a 1.10 multiplier represented by ten percentage points above Sneaking rank one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_summoning_essence
extractions.description: Summoning essence gain: a 1.10 multiplier represented by ten percentage points above Summoning rank one

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_spelunking_max_stamina
extractions.description: Spelunking maximum stamina for everyone: fifteen points when the Spelunking rank is above three

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_spelunking_daily_page_reads
extractions.description: Spelunking daily page reads: three additional reads when the Spelunking rank is above four

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_spelunking_stamina_regen
extractions.description: Spelunking stamina regeneration: ten percentage points when the Spelunking rank is above five

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_spelunking_amber_gain
extractions.description: Spelunking amber gain: a 1.50 multiplier represented by fifty percentage points above Spelunking rank six

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_mining_cards_passive
extractions.description: Mining card effect access: all Mining cards become passive above rank two

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_total_damage
extractions.description: Total damage: begins at seven points and adds five points for each eligible skill above rank two; Mining, Chopping, Fishing, Catching, Trapping, and Worship do not contribute because their cards are passive

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_total_all_skill_experience
extractions.description: All-skill experience: begins at seven points and adds ten points for each of the 18 skill categories above rank three

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_total_all_skill_efficiency
extractions.description: All-skill efficiency: begins at seven points and adds five points for each eligible skill above rank four; Mining, Chopping, Fishing, Catching, Trapping, and Worship do not contribute because their cards are passive

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_total_printer_output
extractions.description: Printer output: begins at seven points and adds one percentage point for each of the 18 skill categories above rank five

extractions.label: rift_skill_mastery_total_large_all_skill_experience
extractions.description: Large all-skill experience: begins at seven points and adds twenty-five points for each of the 18 skill categories above rank six
